ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Organization credential. Identifies the organization; does not identify an individual end user.

BearerAuth.description: User Access JWT for protected user-facing routes.

RefreshCookie.name: __Host-aihub_refresh
RefreshCookie.description: Host-only Secure HttpOnly cookie containing the opaque refresh credential.

BffClientSecret.name: X-AIHUB-Client-Secret
BffClientSecret.description: Server-to-server only, Customer Web BFF. Static client secret proving the caller is the AIHUB-owned Customer Web backend. Not a browser credential and not an Organization key: a browser never sends it, and these routes are not for a browser to call.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id
CorrelationId.description: Client-supplied trace id, echoed back in `meta.correlation_id`. Never used as the request's own identity — that is always AIHUB-generated as `meta.request_id`.

UserIdentity.name: X-User-Identity
UserIdentity.description: Identifies the end user on user-scoped operations. For an Organization with an active identity configuration it must be a Signed User Assertion; otherwise it is a Declared User ID: 1-256 visible ASCII characters with no spaces, compared exactly as sent.

OrganizationId.description: Case-sensitive Organization ID prefixed with org_; its suffix starts with an ASCII letter or digit and may contain ASCII letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens.

Error400.description: INVALID_REQUEST | IDENTITY_JWKS_URL_UNSAFE | IDENTITY_JWKS_INVALID | AUTH_VERIFICATION_TOKEN_INVALID | AUTH_VERIFICATION_PASSWORD_INVALID | AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_INVALID | ORGANIZATION_INVITE_TOKEN_INVALID

Error401.description: UNAUTHORIZED | USER_IDENTITY_REQUIRED | INVALID_USER_IDENTITY | AUTH_CREDENTIALS_INVALID | AUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID | AUTH_USER_ACCESS_TOKEN_REQUIRED | AUTH_USER_ACCESS_TOKEN_INVALID | AUTH_WEB_SESSION_INVALID

Error409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT | AUTH_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE | AUTH_MFA_ALREADY_ENABLED | ORGANIZATION_MEMBER_EXISTS | ORGANIZATION_OWNER_REQUIRED | ORGANIZATION_IDENTITY_ISSUER_CONFLICT | ORGANIZATION_CREATION_LIMIT_REACHED | AVATAR_CHANGED

Retry-After.description: Present whenever the error includes retry_after_ms: the same wait in whole seconds, rounded up.
Present whenever the error includes retry_after_ms: the same wait in whole seconds, rounded up.

RateLimit-Policy.description: Advisory. The per-minute limit of the API key, for example `"per-key";q=600;w=60`. Present on routes the per-key limit applies to.

RateLimit.description: Advisory. What the API key has left of its current window and the whole seconds until it resets, for example `"per-key";r=0;t=13`.

Error503.description: IDENTITY_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE | IDENTITY_JWKS_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE | IDENTITY_CONFIG_CACHE_UNAVAILABLE | DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE | AUTH_ARGON2_CAPACITY | EMAIL_DELIVERY_BACKLOGGED | AUTH_WEB_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE | REDIS_UNAVAILABLE | RETRY_BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE | AVATAR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE | SPEAKING_AUDIO_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE | WRITING_CHART_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE | AI_SERVICE_THROTTLED | AI_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE

Retry-After.description: Present whenever the error includes retry_after_ms: the same wait in whole seconds, rounded up.

AuthRateLimited.description: An authentication rate budget is exhausted. The refusal is the same one on every authentication route, so the response always carries the wait in `retry_after_ms` and, whenever a wait is known, in the `Retry-After` header.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying, rounded up from the longest exhausted window.
